description: We are a team of high schoolers in JB, Malaysia. Our team is exited about Astronomy and have a little bit of programming knowledge, including JavaScript and Python. We are looking for members who are more comfortable with coding in these languages too and can read and interpret data as well as those who are passionate about Astronomy, Storytelling, Animation, Designing, Marketing, etc. Together we can create a project that can captivate people and help them appreciate Science a little more.
summary:
MARS SALVAGE: EARTH LINK is a browser-based educational game that brings NASA’s retired Mars missions back into the spotlight.

Players guide a robotic rover across Mars-inspired terrain to locate, scan, and recover abandoned spacecraft components, discovering the engineering stories behind them. Guided by NOVA (ASTRA-9), an original virtual companion, players face challenges involving solar energy, Martian dust storms, and simulated Earth–Mars communication delays.

Inspired by NASA’s Mars Trek maps, Deep Space Network, and planetary science resources, the game combines exploration, problem-solving, and scientific learning. A bilingual English Science Field Guide makes space engineering more accessible to students around the world.

Our goal is to transform forgotten space hardware into an exciting learning experience, inspiring the next generation of scientists, engineers, and explorers.
